test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-2 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Case-Management-070
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-2.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: a small set of nonprivileged service credentials is rotated every 100 days instead of the documented 90-day target. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
